index.title: Automate Routine Tasks with a Digital Assistant
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Routine Tasks. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Routine Tasks with a Digital Assistant. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help,
index.what_happened_excerpt: A person connected their online services to a digital assistant, which then automated routine tasks like scheduling appointments and completing online transactions.
